issues.title: Author badge is missing from messages
issues.body:
Collapsed messages used to include a badge for the message author. The badge was the relevant color for that force, and contained the `Role` name for that player.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/124174932-dbad6e00-daa4-11eb-9c70-73e03bb8294b.png)

We've lost that in current game:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/124174992-ea942080-daa4-11eb-8b8d-118004f1652c.png)

Hmm, maybe it's that dark circle.  Maybe we're just missing the text element.
